The source-state check uses actual captured matrices and an API-before target background; it does not execute original D3D12 bytecode or reproduce subsequent passes.

validation.currentScopeNote: Historical pre-capture previous implementation: all existing PNG error numbers below are retained, not measurements of the current captured-mesh default renderer.
validation.method: Complete 200x165 RGBA region, including the entire book, texels, edges and clear background margins, at GUI5. RGB MAE retains its historical 3-channel denominator; RGBA MAE, all-channel changed pixels and alpha error are also measured. No image mask or border exclusion. Native crop [916,350,200,165], web crop [0,15,200,165] in a 200x200 canvas. Title above and unrelated inventory slots below lie outside this region.

newScaleObservation.scope: New GUI scale of the already-known open pose; no coefficient, mesh, texture, camera or alignment fitting on this sample.
newScaleObservation.sourceRegistration: Observed panel [940,365,704,664]; source book offset [13,10.5]*4 gives canvas [992,407,160,160]. Scale the previous complete GUI5 ROI by 4/5.
newScaleObservation.limitation: Nonzero full-region differences and 1px width mismatch remain. Improvement on a new scale is not new-pose or native-renderer certification.

validation.regression: Optional local native samples use pinned PNG signatures, dimensions and SHA256. The source-fixed candidate must improve complete-region RGB error sums (<41093 open, <17483 closed), changed RGBA pixels (<2239 open, <1281 closed) and RGBA MAE over the previous empirical equation, with alphaChangedPixels=0. Existing <1.5 RGB MAE/<10% unlit and one-pixel bounds checks remain. Nonzero residual pixels must never be called exact agreement.
validation.scope: Two already-known open/closed samples at the default pose. Both must improve with one source-fixed coefficient set; neither is a statistically unseen held-out pose. Unknown animations/angles and native renderer equivalence remain unverified.
validation.coordinateScope: Crop coordinates refer only to the existing pinned user-owned PNGs. Their full image dimensions do not establish the exact client rectangle or capture pipeline; no whole-frame capture equivalence is inferred.

nativeCalibration.currentScopeNote: Historical pre-capture PNG pose/lighting calibration of the previous implementation; retained numbers are not relabeled as current default results.
nativeCalibration.captureMethod: Game-window Alt+PrintScreen -> system Paint paste at original dimensions -> PNG save. Files have actual PNG signature 89504e470d0a1a0a; earlier CUA JPEGs are excluded as exact references.
nativeCalibration.pitchEvidence: At a common GUI5 canvas origin [916,335], pitch20 gives web closed [60,39,75,126] and open [16,33,168,126], matching native positions/heights with one extra native edge-coverage column. The prior pitch25 closed top/height was [35,124], requiring a state-dependent mismatch.

lighting.normalSpace: Unit geometric face normal after part fold, X(pi), GUI pose yaw, then final camera pitch/roll. Translation never affects the reconstructed normal; actual native model matrix/input normal.w is not captured.
lighting.formula: I = 0.725 - 0.1*nx^2 + 0.1*nz^2 + 0.275*ny; fragment RGB = original atlas RGB*I, original alpha unchanged. This reduces the installed Entity and MeshFallback equations only for white TileLightColor, TileLightIntensity=1 and OverlayColor.a=0.
lighting.classification: Source-fixed installed-material shader candidate with assumed UI uniforms and normal pose, not a recovered book renderer. One equation/no per-state coefficients improves open and closed complete native ROIs; mesh/UV remain the prior reconstruction.

nativeCalibration.residuals: Closed changed RGBA pixels=656, open=1683 in complete 33000-pixel regions; alpha agrees throughout. Residuals remain at partial coverage, texel/face boundaries, UV/pose and some color transitions; maximum channel errors remain147 closed/166 open. NEAREST/antialias=false is retained: global LINEAR, MSAA and supersampling experiments all worsened both complete reference errors.

sourceShaderEvidence.currentScopeNote: Historical installed Entity/MeshFallback candidate audit. ActualPSO795 captured stages have different whole-program bytes; formula similarity does not identify the runtime material name.
sourceShaderEvidence.method: System d3dcompiler_47.dll D3DDisassemble; fixed whole-file hashes, DXBC byte ranges/container lengths/stage hashes, arithmetic dependency checks. No binary or shader assembly is distributed.
sourceShaderEvidence.normalizationDifference: Entity stage normalizes a transformed vec4 with dp4; MeshFallback uses transformed xyz/dp3. The reconstruction assumes a unit xyz face normal, normal.w=0 and rotation-only pose; the actual book model matrix/input normal is not captured.
